rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Instagram MCP Server provides comprehensive Instagram integration capabilities for AI assistants, enabling authentication with two-factor support, content discovery through user profiles, timelines, stories, and detailed post information, search functionality for accounts and explore content, and engagement actions including liking posts and comments, adding replies, and following users. Built with TypeScript, the implementation uses unofficial Instagram API access methods and includes tools for viewing home feeds from followed accounts, retrieving post details and comments, and performing various social media interactions. Designed for social media management workflows, content research, and automated Instagram operations within AI-assisted environments, though users should note the unofficial API usage and potential account restrictions.
